title: Work Kit and Uniform Confirmation
summary: Confirm your work kit, uniforms, and footwear before you resume.
successMessage: Your work kit and uniform confirmation has been saved.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: Every therapist is expected to resume work prepared, clean, presentable and equipped with the personal items required to maintain professional standards throughout the workday.
The Work Kit and Uniform are part of the therapist's personal responsibility and preparation for work.
All required items must be confirmed before resumption.

sections.title: 2. Work Kit
paragraphs: Every therapist should maintain a personal work kit containing the following essential items:

sections.title: Relevance & Usage
paragraphs: The work kit is intended to help therapists maintain:
sections.closing: Therapists are expected to use these items appropriately and replenish them when necessary. The work kit should be treated as a personal responsibility. Staff should not routinely depend on colleagues to provide these items.

sections.title: 3. Uniform Requirements
paragraphs: Every therapist must have at least two (2) approved Zura Spa uniforms.
Having two uniforms ensures that the therapist has a clean uniform available while the other is being washed or unavailable.
Uniforms must be clean, neat, properly maintained, presentable, and worn correctly during work hours.
The uniform is to be worn only within the facility. Therapists must:
list: Arrive at the spa in mufti.
Change into their approved uniform before work.
Change back into mufti before leaving the facility.
Change out of uniform before stepping outside the facility during the workday where required.

sections.title: 4. Uniform Provision
paragraphs: Where necessary, Zura Spa may provide uniforms to therapists pro bono to enable them to meet the required uniform standard.

Where a therapist receives uniforms from the spa under an arrangement requiring repayment, the therapist may pay the applicable cost within one month, according to the arrangement communicated by the company.
Regardless of how the uniform is obtained, the therapist remains responsible for maintaining and properly using it.

sections.title: 5. Required Footwear
paragraphs: Every therapist must have black Crocs or the approved black work footwear specified by Zura Spa. The footwear must be:
list: Comfortable and safe for extended periods of standing and movement.

sections.title: 6. Confirmation Before Resumption
paragraphs: The following must be confirmed before a therapist resumes work. A therapist should not consider their onboarding/resumption requirements complete until the required work kit, uniform and footwear have been confirmed.
Being prepared for work is part of the job.
